summary: V496 increments the runtime spec version to 496 and keeps transaction version 2. This PR adds no runtime calls, storage migrations, or parameter changes. It tracks 51 root-controlled settings and excludes the nomination minimum factor from generated proposals. It hardens the signing workflow with an independently verified call hash and a pinned multisig timepoint. Merging the files does not apply them. Signers should use the updated SDK from a trusted checkout and regenerate proposals after a runtime upgrade.
